concept.name: Bagging
concept.definition: An ensemble method that fits base estimators independently on resampled observations or features and averages or votes their predictions.
concept.intuition: It is a learnable mapping or representation used to turn features into predictions or groups.
concept.mechanics: Draw bootstrap samples, train one base model per sample, obtain predictions from all models, and aggregate them.
concept.failure_modes: Flexible models can fit noise, shift under new regimes, and conceal instability when tuning is repeated on the same validation data.
concept.misconceptions: Greater model complexity or in-sample accuracy does not by itself imply better out-of-sample trading results.
concept.example: One hundred trees trained on bootstrap samples vote 62 to 38 for the positive class.
